support.p: Script: 'bru tsha. Lines per folio: 9; 8 on fol. 28b; 10 on fol. 57b; 4 on fol. 96a. Numbering in letters on the recto of the folios, from 2 to 96. Folio number on last folio: go drug bzhugs s+ho. An additional folio numbered "nyer brgyad gong ma" (upper 28) occurs between fol. 27 and fol. 28. Images of folios 87a and 86b are misplaced in the [Z5AUD7GQ]. They appear in the following order: 86a (p. 606), 87b (p. 607), 87a (p. 608), 86b (p. 609), 88a (p. 610). Orthography: - Palatalization of ma by ya btags (frequent on the first folio, rare afterwards) - Superabundant 'a rjes 'jug (ex. gzhi', dbyeʾ) - Flexible use of prefixes for verbal forms and their derivatives: sgrub bya/bsgrub bya, sgrub pa/bsgrub pa, gzung bya/bzung bya, gzung don/bzung don, gzung yul/bzung yul, gcad pa'i yul can/bcad paʾi yul can - The la don takes the form du after final –b (ex. kun rdzob du, rab du dbye ba) and final –g (ex. cig du) - The particle pa/ba takes the form pa after final –ng (ex. mthong pa, snang pa) and final – l (ex. sel pa, but one sometimes finds ʾkhrul ba in alternance with 'khrul pa) - Different spelling used alternatively for some words (ex. cig or gcig, the tsom or the tshom) - Spelling differing from classical Tibetan, used consistently: log rtogs (for log rtog), rkang thil (for rkang mthil) - la sogs pa consistently spelled lasogs pa - Enclitics ('ang, 'am, 'i, 'o) frequently appear as a separate syllable - Consistent use of the tsheg before a shad. - Use of the bindu instead of final ma (especially in insertions) - Character ṇa for med (rare) - Use of the reverse i (gigu log) (rare, ex. 3b8: 'di'ï, 6b2 ngo bo cïg, 6b2 po'ï) - Use of numerals for numbers (ex. 2 for gnyis) or for their phonetic value (ex. skad 1 for skad cig) Insertions below the line or in the top/bottom margins (mostly corrections; some additional glosses)

pa nges na na tshogs pasa grub pas rtags don med pa dang | tshogs pa las gzhan la 'jug pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa la byas pa lasogs pa rtags ma yin par 'gyur ro ||

gsum pa gsum du 'dod pa dgag pa ni kha cig phyogs chos dang rjes 'gro dang ldog pa gsum du smra ba phyogs chos ni rtsod gzhi la yod pa
yin na | rjes 'gro dang ma 'brel pa'i ldog pa 'ba' zhig pa de gang yin | mi mthun phyogs la 'jug mi srid pa 'am ma mthong pa yin | dang po ltar na de dang phyogs chos kyis rigs mi mthun pa mtha' dag bcad pas rjes 'gro la rnam gcad med do | gal te rtsod gzhi la yod par nges rung gi phyogs chos dang mi mthun phyogs la 'jug mi srid pa'i ldog pa mnyan bya la yod
kyang de rtags ma yin pas dpe la rjes su 'gro ba'i rjes 'gros‹rjes 'gros› mnyan bya bcad pa yin no zhe na | mtshan nyid nges pa la ma ltos na de ltar gyur yang ldog pa ni ldog pa nges pa yin pas de nyid kyis mnyan bya bcad pas rjes 'gro la ci ltos |
gal te mi mthun phyogs la ma mthong pa ldog pa yin no zhe na de dang phyogs chos kyi steng du bsnan par bya ba'i rjes 'gro gang yin mthun phyogs
la mthong pa 'am | mthun phyogs kho na la yod pa yin | dang po ltar na lhag ldan yang dag du 'gyur te tshul gsum tshang pa'i phyir ro | gnyis pa ltar na de dang phyogs chos kyi rigs mi mthun pa mtha' dag bcad pas ldog pa smos pa don med do ||
bzhi pa tshul gnyis su bsgrub pa ni rtsod gzhi la mthong pa'i phyogs chosphyogs dang mi mthun phyogs la 'jug mi srid par nges
pa'i ldog pa gnyis kho na rtags kyi mtshan nyid yin no | kha cig phyogs chosphyogs dang mi mthun phyogs la mi srid pa'i ldog pa gnyis kyis kyang rtags su mtshon nus la phyogs chos dang mthun phyogs kho na la yod pa'i rjes 'gro gnyis kyis‹kyis› kyang rtags su mtshon nus so zhes zer ba de'i ltar na dus gzhan du mi sdod pas kyang mi gnas par mtshon nus la rgyus bskyed pas kyang
mtshon nus so zhes zer ba ji ltar dgag | dus gnyis par mi sdod pa las rgyus bskyed pa don ldog gzhan yin pas de'i mtshon bya mi rtag pa las kyang don ldog gzhan du gyur to zhe na | phyogs chos dang rjes 'gro de phyogs chos dang ldog pa las don gyi ldog pa gzhan yin pa de'i mtshon bya gtan tshigs kyi tha snyad las kyang don gyi ldog pa gzhan yin te de'i mtshan nyid
ma yin no ||ma yin no zhe na ||
gzhan yang phyogs chos dang mthun phyogs kho na la yod pa tshul gnyis su smra na dgag bya dang 'gal ba rtsod gzhi la grub pa zhes pa'i‹pa'i› tshul cig rtags kyi mtshan nyid du 'gyur ro || phyogs chos yod pas rtags yin na 'gal ba rtags su 'gyur ro zhe na | phyogs chos dang rjes 'gro yod pa rtags yin na thun mong gi ma
nges pa rtags su 'gyur ro | de la rjes 'gro med do zhe na | 'gal ba la phyogs chos med do || 'o na rtags rtsod gzhi la med par 'gyur ro zhe na | ma nges pa'ang rtags mthun phyogs la med par 'gyur ro || mthun phyogs la yod pa tsam rjes 'gro ma yin te mthun phyogs kho na la yod pa yin la de ma nges pa la‹la› med do zhe na | rtsod gzhi la mthong pa tsam
phyogs chos ma yin te dgag bya dang 'gal ba rtsod gzhi la mthong pa yin la de 'gal ba la med do | 'o na dgag bya dang 'gal ba dang rtsod gzhi la mthong pa tshul gnyis yin te tshul cig ma yin no zhe na‹tshul cig ma yin no zhe na› | khyed kyi ltar na'ang rtsod gzhi la mthong pa dang mthun phyogs kho na la yod pas mthun phyogs la mthong pa dang gzhan mi mthun phyogs la khegs pa dang tshul gsum du gyur pa yin no ||
gal te mthun phyogs kho na la yod ces pa mthun phyogs la bsgrubs pa dang gzhan la bkag pa'i dgag sgrub gnyis tshogs pa yin pa ltar mi mthun phyogs la 'jug mi srid pa'i ldog pa lamiThe ditto deleted below reads "la". The reading with "mi" is more difficult to make sense of, as the phrase would read "negative concommitance is the combination of affirmation and negation, namely affirmation in dissimilar instances and negation elsewhere", so that one should supplement "affirmation of absence in dissimilar instances". mi mthun phyogs la bsgrubs pa dang gzhan la 'jug pa bkag pa'i dgag sgrub gnyis tshogs pa yin no zhe na | dgag bsgrub gnyis tshogs pa ni ma yin dgag yin te snang pa
dang rang bzhin med pa tshogs pa'i sgyu ma lta bu bzhin no | mi mthun phyogs la 'jug mi srid pa yang ldog pa gnyis tshogs pa yin na ma yin dgag du 'gyur na 'di ni med dgag kho na yin no | mthun phyogs kho na la‹la› yod payod pa {yin pa ltar mi mthun phyogs la 'jug mi srid pa'i ldog pa la mthun phyogs la bsgrub pa dang gzhan la 'jug pa bkag}
ldog pa{pa'i dgag bsgrub gnyis tshogs pa} ldog pa gnyis tshogs pa yin pas ma yin dgag du thal zhe na 'dod pa nyid yin pas ga la mtshungs |

phyogs dang 'brel pa ma yin dgag yin pa ltar mi mthun phyogs dang 'brel pa bkag pa 'ang ma yin dgag du 'gyur ro || 'o na sngon po bsgrubs pa ma yin dgag yin pa ltar sngo ma yin bkag pa 'ang ma yin dgag du thal lo zhe na 'dod pa nyid de dgag pa dgag pa sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir ro ||

yin pas ma yin dgag du thal ba 'dod par mi nus te mtshungs pa ma yin no ||||

rgyu mtshan zhes bya ba yin la nog dang lkog shal la rlom yul gyi bsgrub byas khyab pa'ang 'dod pas spyod pa'i brda' lan cig zhugs pas nges pa yin no |
